faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Business API in Spain?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API, also called the WhatsApp Business Platform, helps growing businesses in Spain communicate with customers without managing every conversation manually. It supports bulk messaging, AI chatbots, CRM integrations, automated notifications, and customer support with multiple agents.
  • Businesses across Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and the rest of Spain can use it to manage customer enquiries, booking confirmations, order updates, and marketing campaigns.
  • With MSG91, businesses can automate WhatsApp conversations, run campaigns without coding, and manage customer support through Hello, all from one platform.

faqs.question: Why should businesses in Spain choose MSG91 as their WhatsApp Business API provider?
faqs.answer:
• Managing customer communication shouldn't mean switching between multiple platforms. MSG91 brings WhatsApp automation, marketing campaigns, AI chatbots, and customer support together in one place.
  • Businesses can use a no-code dashboard to run WhatsApp campaigns, automate repetitive conversations, and manage customer enquiries as they grow.
  • And MSG91 goes beyond WhatsApp. With MSG91 One API, businesses can connect SMS, RCS, email, WhatsApp, and voice through unified communication workflows.
  • You also get MSG91 Hello, an AI-powered customer support platform with a shared inbox for managing conversations across teams.
  • From marketing campaigns to everyday customer support, MSG91 helps Spanish businesses simplify communication without juggling multiple tools.

faqs.question: What is the pricing of WhatsApp Business API in Spain?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing in Spain includes messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard GBP pricing, helping businesses reduce communication expenses.
  • MSG91's rates for Spanish numbers (+34), in GBP, are:
    • Marketing: £0.04606 per message
    • Utility: £0.01302 per message
    • Authentication: £0.01302 per message
    • Service: £0.01303 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs £6/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, sending 10,000 billable marketing messages costs £460.60 with MSG91 compared with £509 at Meta's standard rate, saving £48.40 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • Actual savings depend on messaging volume, applicable pricing tiers, and billing arrangements.
  • For a detailed breakdown, explore MSG91 WhatsApp Business API Pricing in Spain and Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Pricing.

faqs.question: Can businesses in Spain send bulk WhatsApp campaigns for Black Friday, Rebajas, and other promotions?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. Spanish businesses can use MSG91 to run Black Friday campaigns, Rebajas de Enero, summer sales, Christmas offers, and product launches without building a custom API integration.
  • With MSG91, you can upload opted-in contacts through CSV files, personalise approved message templates with images and offers, schedule campaigns, and track delivery performance.
  • For example, a fashion retailer in Madrid can send personalised January sale offers with discounts and shopping links to customers who have agreed to receive promotions.
  • MSG91 also supports opt-out management, making it easier for customers to unsubscribe from unwanted messages.
  • Businesses must follow EU GDPR, Spain's LOPDGDD, applicable LSSI rules, and Meta's messaging policies. Marketing generally requires appropriate prior authorisation, with a limited existing-customer exception where legal conditions are met. Customers must also have an easy way to opt out.
  • Explore MSG91 Campaign to automate marketing and customer engagement.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 AI WhatsApp chatbots communicate in Spanish, Catalan, Basque, and Galician?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 AI WhatsApp chatbots can be configured to communicate in Spanish, Catalan, Basque, and Galician, depending on the AI model and configuration.
  • What makes them more powerful? You can combine rule-based steps and AI-powered conversations within a single chatbot, instead of building separate bots.
  • The chatbot can connect with 2,000+ apps, make API calls, and access information from connected systems to handle simple questions and complex enquiries, including bookings, order tracking, and product recommendations.
  • Businesses can also choose from multiple AI models and configure backup models, helping conversations continue when the primary model becomes unavailable.
  • For example, a Barcelona hotel can use one chatbot to collect booking details, check room availability through APIs, and answer complex guest enquiries using AI.
  • When human assistance is needed, conversations move to agents through MSG91 Hello, where teams manage chats from a shared inbox or mobile app.
  • Explore MSG91 WhatsApp AI Chatbots, the Shopify integration guide, and the Hello mobile app.

faqs.question: How can businesses in Spain reduce WhatsApp customer support costs after Meta's October 2026 pricing changes?
faqs.answer:
• Since October 1, 2026, Meta has charged for WhatsApp service messages beyond its monthly free allowance. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number remain free each month, while additional messages are chargeable.
  • Utility templates sent within an active customer service window also became chargeable, subject to applicable exceptions.
  • For hotels, online stores, and service businesses handling hundreds of customer enquiries daily, these expenses can add up.
  • MSG91 Chat Window offers a simpler way to continue conversations: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • Customers begin on WhatsApp and move to a dedicated Chat Window through a link. AI chatbots and human agents can then continue assisting them through Hello without sending every response through WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window don't incur Meta's WhatsApp messaging charges. Messages actually sent through WhatsApp remain chargeable.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide to learn more.

faqs.question: Can businesses send WhatsApp OTPs to customers in Spain using MSG91?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 allows businesses in Spain to send WhatsApp OTPs for account verification, logins, and other eligible authentication workflows.
  • For example, an online banking or e-commerce platform can use WhatsApp authentication to help customers verify their identity when signing in or completing supported account activities.
  • But what happens if an OTP doesn't arrive?
  • The MSG91 OTP Widget supports configurable verification and retry options across WhatsApp, SMS, voice, and email, depending on the selected setup.
  • This gives customers alternative ways to receive verification codes without repeatedly restarting the process.
  • Businesses can configure supported OTP workflows or integrate them through MSG91 APIs.
  • Explore MSG91 OTP and the OTP Widget integration guide.

faqs.question: Which industries in Spain benefit most from WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer:
• Businesses that handle frequent customer enquiries, reservations, orders, and follow-ups can benefit from WhatsApp Business API automation, especially when customers prefer quick and convenient communication.
  • Some relevant industries in Spain include:
    • Tourism and Hospitality: Automate hotel reservations, booking confirmations, check-in instructions, and guest enquiries.
    • E-commerce and Retail: Recover abandoned carts, send order updates, and manage seasonal sales campaigns.
    • Real Estate: Qualify property leads, arrange viewings, and handle enquiries from local and international buyers.
    • Healthcare and Private Clinics: Manage appointment reminders, scheduling enquiries, and routine administrative assistance.
    • Travel Agencies: Share itinerary updates, respond to booking questions, and assist travellers before and during trips.
    • Logistics and Delivery: Send shipment updates, delivery confirmations, and scheduling notifications.
  • With MSG91, businesses can connect WhatsApp to their existing systems through supported integrations or custom APIs.
  • AI chatbots handle repetitive enquiries while human agents focus on conversations that need personal attention.
  • Explore MSG91 Hello to manage customer communication from one place.

faqs.question: How can businesses in Spain set up WhatsApp Business API and get support from MSG91?
faqs.answer:
• Getting started with MSG91 is simple, and you're supported at every step. Our onboarding team helps with Meta Business Portfolio setup, number verification, chatbot configuration, and launching your first WhatsApp campaign.
  • Do I need a NIF, and can I keep my +34 number? A NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) or business registration documents may be requested for additional Meta verification, but aren't required for every initial setup.
  • Already using WhatsApp Business? You may be able to migrate an eligible +34 number. However, WhatsApp Coexistence isn't currently supported for Spanish numbers, so simultaneous use of the Business App and Cloud API on the same number isn't available through that feature.
  • Need help? MSG91 offers 24/7 customer assistance, combining expert human support through email, WhatsApp, calls, and scheduled Google Meet sessions with round-the-clock AI that handles both routine questions and complex technical enquiries.
  • With MSG91 Hello, you can also offer AI-powered support and seamless human handovers to your own customers.
  • Explore the WhatsApp onboarding guide or contact MSG91 support.
